description: Set or replace the https URL we POST events to, and the event types it gets. Saving also switches the endpoint back on and clears its failure count. This is how you turn one back on after we switched it off because every delivery to it failed for 5 days. The signing secret (whsec_…) is in the answer only when this call makes one: on the first save, or with `rotateSecret: true`, which stops the old secret at once. Each POST body is `{ id, type, seq, generation, timestamp, data }`. `id` is the delivery's id (also the `x-colding-delivery` header): dedupe on it, because a delivery can arrive twice. `seq` is the event's number in `list_events`. `generation` is the run of `seq` numbers it belongs to: when it changes, we restored from a backup, so read `list_events` again without a cursor. Check the `x-colding-signature` header with `verifyWebhook` from the SDK. A signed-in owner can call this, or an API key with both setup and read permission. A key can set up the webhook when there is none, or change one a key saved. One a person saved answers 409 `webhookSavedByPerson`: ask the owner with `create_handoff`, kind `manage_webhook`. When a person saves it, it becomes theirs. If the key that saved it stops working (revoked, expired, or made by someone who is no longer the owner), we switch the webhook off within a minute, with `disabledReason` `key_inactive`. Saving it again turns it back on. Then `resend_missed_webhook_events` and `retry_failed_webhook_deliveries` send what it missed, for as long as we keep events (24 hours).

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

rotateSecret.description: true: make a new signing secret and return it. The old one stops working at once, so switch your receiver to the new one right away.
